changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO sys_menu (id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_code, menu_type, path, component, perms, icon, sort, visible, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM sys_menu), 0) + 1, (SELECT id FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'resource' LIMIT 1), 'API管理', 'api_management', 2, '/resource/api', 'resource/ApiManagement', 'resource:api:list', 'Document', 3, 1, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 1, 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'api_management');
